requirements.description: The user requires energy class C or better, so the property must be in class A1, A2, A3, A4, B, or C. The area (180 sqm), capacity (14 people), and public transport preferences are not energy columns and are outside this extraction.
The user prefers properties near public transport. Per the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71), the property should be in the top quartile for transport accessibility.

The user explicitly requires a minimum gross floor area of 180 sqm. The capacity of 14 people is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. Energy class, public transport proximity, and the Turin location are outside the reference columns or handled by other agents (Location Agent for geography). No typology is stated in the request, so typologies is empty.
